zh.title: 星宇航空規劃2027年開航臺北—雪梨—奧克蘭　擬以A330neo執飛
zh.summary: 星宇航空規劃2027年經雪梨延伸奧克蘭，擬使用A330neo。主管受訪表示初期每週4至5班、逐步增至每日一班；確切首航日期及完整班表仍待公布。
body: 星宇航空規劃於2027年開航臺北桃園國際機場（TPE）經澳洲雪梨機場（SYD）至紐西蘭奧克蘭機場（AKL）的航線，拓展大洋洲航網。雪梨機場已於2026年6月2日公告，雪梨將成為星宇在澳洲的首個航點，航班並將延伸至奧克蘭。
依Executive Traveller於10月1日刊出的報導，星宇航空策略長Simon Liu表示，該航線規劃使用Airbus A330neo，初期每週營運4至5班，再逐步增至每日一班。確切首航日期、航班時刻及售票安排仍待公布，截至目前查得的公開資料，尚無法確認是否於2027年第二季開航。
臺北至奧克蘭的規劃包含雪梨中途停靠，旅客不宜將其理解為兩地間的不經停航班。至於雪梨停留時間、是否須下機及後續搭乘程序，仍應以正式班表與旅客服務公告為準。
除串聯臺灣、澳洲與紐西蘭外，報導亦指出，星宇有意爭取雪梨—奧克蘭區間旅客，與澳洲航空（Qantas）及紐西蘭航空（Air New Zealand）等業者競爭。若開放單獨購買該區間機票，將涉及航空公司在自本國出發或返回本國的航線上、載運兩個外國間旅客的第五航權，實際營運仍須符合相關航權與核准條件。
紐西蘭求職平台SEEK已可查得星宇奧克蘭營運相關徵才資訊，顯示當地團隊正進行籌備。不過，徵才資訊本身不足以確認辦公室已正式成立；辦公據點、正式啟用時間及航線最終安排，仍待星宇進一步公布。

en.title: STARLUX Plans Taipei–Sydney–Auckland Service in 2027 with A330neo
en.summary: STARLUX plans an A330neo service to Auckland via Sydney in 2027. An executive interview indicates four to five weekly flights initially, increasing to daily; launch dates and schedules remain unannounced.
body: STARLUX Airlines plans to connect Taipei Taoyuan (TPE), Sydney and Auckland (AKL) in 2027. Sydney Airport (SYD) announced on June 2, 2026, that Sydney would be the carrier's first Australian destination, with an onward service to Auckland.

In an Executive Traveller report published on October 1, STARLUX Chief Strategy Officer Simon Liu said the route would use the Airbus A330neo, starting with four to five weekly flights and gradually increasing to daily. A launch date, timetable and ticket-sale arrangements remain to be announced. The public information reviewed does not confirm a second-quarter 2027 launch.

The planned Taipei–Auckland journey includes a stop in Sydney and should not be understood as a nonstop service. Stopover duration, disembarkation requirements and onward boarding procedures remain subject to the published schedule and passenger guidance.

The report also indicates that STARLUX intends to attract Sydney–Auckland passengers alongside its through traffic, competing with operators including Qantas and Air New Zealand. Selling this sector separately would involve fifth-freedom traffic rights, allowing an airline to carry passengers between two foreign countries on a service originating or ending in its home country, subject to the relevant rights and approvals.

STARLUX recruitment listings for Auckland operations are visible on New Zealand job platform SEEK, indicating preparations for a local team. These listings alone do not establish that an office has formally opened. Office details, opening dates and final route arrangements await further airline announcements.
